modalLead: Watched news stops counting after a while, the bell holds one line for it, and every row in the bell says how old it is.

items.text: News stops counting after a while. Count news as unread for in Config → Watch feeds sets how long: from 4 hours to 30 days, 1 day by default. Older news leaves the purple count, the hover card and the bell.
The bell holds one line for new news instead of a toast. The hover card pages through ten items, and the purple count stops at 9+.
Every row in the bell says how old it is. The time sits on the right and starts over when the row gets worse.
The bell panel draws over the view headers of the Inbox, Containers and Glances views, and the bell rings only for more, not for less.
